svg.desc: Portrait About view with a back control and vertically stacked, readable creator, weather source, recommendation, privacy, and art-credit sections.
svg.text: ff forecastfits
← Back to the forecast
THE STORY BEHIND THE FIT
Weather advice,
with a little style.
A quick campus outfit idea and practical
reminders, informed by the forecast.
Made by
Jack Lepien · Claude Code development help
Weather data
Open-Meteo Forecast and Geocoding APIs.
Linked attribution; data under CC BY 4.0.
Free tier is for non-commercial use only.
Brand promotion needs commercial terms.
Recommendation method
Daily high selects the outfit's base layers.
Rain and snow add different outerwear.
UV, hydration, cold, and storm reminders
are rules, not medical or official advice.
GUIDANCE SOURCES
CDC · WHO UV Index · National Weather Service
The two-hour tip is not a safety guarantee.
Your privacy
No account or tracking. Only the latest location
is saved on this device. Geolocation is optional
and coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo.
Artwork and credits
Original SVGs by Jack Lepien · Claude Code assistance
